subject: Trial readiness & procurement decision matrix for Brightmetric
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightmetric.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightmetric.com
Date: 2027-06-02T15:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick call recap — procurement & trial questions

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the call earlier — quick follow up from procurement side. They asked for clarity on three items before we can route the PO:

1) What the formal invoice & billing start trigger is (trial end vs consumption threshold).
2) A short statement of work or service description to attach to the PO.
3) Do you support marketplace purchase (we prefer that if possible).

Procurement also asked whether we can accept a 30-day invoice payment term and whether your standard PO template works. I can loop legal if needed.

I can also confirm internal timelines: once we get the SOW + invoice template, procurement estimates 6–8 business days for approval.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Senior Product Manager, Brightmetric
samir.patel@brightmetric.com
+1 415-555-0199

--
Attachment: Brightmetric_SOW_request.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightmetric.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-02T16:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick call recap — procurement & trial questions

Hi Samir — great speaking with you all. Recap + next steps below so procurement has everything in one place.

Call recap (short):
- Brightmetric is ready to run a 2-week pilot (3 primary flows) to validate generation quality and latency under expected traffic.
- Desired billing start: prefer to start billing only after pilot if success criteria met; alternative is start billing on a set calendar date.
- Procurement preference: PO with 30-day terms, marketplace interest TBD.

Requested items from Redwood (we can deliver today/tomorrow):
- Short SOW / service description (1 page) — I will attach a templated SOW and a sample invoice.
- Standard PO template accepted — attached PO_Template_Redwood.pdf.
- Marketplace procurement: we support AWS Marketplace purchases for annual commitments; for short pilots, PO directly to Redwood is simplest.

Success criteria (suggested; open to edits):
- Usage: >= 100k tokens total across the pilot (approx. 50k retokenized prompts + 50k completion tokens).
- Functionality: 3 defined flows running end-to-end with no >1% error rate for generation responses.
- Latency: median per-request latency <= 400ms at pilot load.

Commercial path options (please pick one):
A) PO first, billing starts on the agreed calendar date (e.g., 2027-06-21) regardless of threshold.
B) PO in place, billing starts once success criteria are met during the pilot (we invoice from that date).
C) Card on file for pilot, switch to PO/marketplace for production.

Next steps I recommend:
- Samir: confirm preferred commercial path (A/B/C) and marketplace interest.
- Procurement: review attached SOW + PO template; confirm 30-day payment term OK.
- Marcus: once Samir confirms, can you own pilot ops and MAP tracking?
- Lauren: can you weigh in on any contract checklist items for PO vs Marketplace?

I attached the PO template and a short mutual action plan (MAP) link for tracking. I also attached a one-page SOW draft. If procurement wants, we can accept a PO now and set billing to start on the date we all agree.

Thanks — I’ll standby for confirmation and will loop legal/procurement as needed.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0102

--
Attachments: PO_Template_Redwood.pdf, Redwood_MAP_Brightmetric.xlsx

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightmetric.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightmetric.com
Date: 2027-06-03T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick call recap — procurement & trial questions

Thanks Olga — this is helpful. Procurement reviewed the PO template and SOW draft. A couple notes: 

- PO with 30-day net looks fine.
- We will route a PO internally but need a slightly longer description in the SOW that includes: data handling assurances (who sees logs), termination conditions for pilot, and an estimated monthly spend cap for the pilot.
- Marketplace: Brightmetric prefers AWS Marketplace for anything >90 days/annual, but for a 2-week pilot we will take a direct PO.

Timeline: procurement will issue a PO once they receive the updated SOW + an invoice line item (they want unit pricing per 1k tokens and estimated cap). Expect ~6 business days to approve after submission.

I attached a quick doc listing the specific SOW language they expect. Can you add it to the SOW and resend?

Samir

--
Attachment: Brightmetric_SOW_request.docx

From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightmetric.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-03T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick call recap — procurement & trial questions

Samir — thanks, noted. I updated the SOW to include the requested language around data handling, pilot termination, and a not-to-exceed pilot cap with unit pricing. New SOW is attached.

Operational note / proposal on billing start:
- We can accept a PO now (procurement route) and set billing to begin on the date the success criteria are satisfied during the pilot (option B). Practically that means: Redwood will flag the MAP item "Pilot Success = True" and generate the invoice with the effective billing start date. If you prefer a calendar-first approach, we can do option A (start billing on 2027-06-21).

Marcus — can you: 1) confirm MAP tracking fields and who will sign off on success, and 2) provide the pilot onboarding schedule (links in MAP)?

Lauren — any quick flags on accepting a PO with the SOW language as written (no custom terms)? If procurement needs minor edits, we can route through standard legal review but prefer to avoid long redlines for a short pilot.

Samir, attaching the revised SOW and the MAP spreadsheet with the success checklist. Once you confirm option B (billing on success), procurement can issue the PO and we can start onboarding immediately; Redwood will not invoice until success is recorded.

Thanks everyone — happy to hop on a 15-min sync if that helps expedite.

Best,
Olga
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

--
Attachments: SOW_Brightmetric_20270603.pdf, Redwood_MAP_Brightmetric.xlsx
